title: NumPy and pandas: arrays and tabular data

spans.text: WHY USE THIS?
NumPy, founded by Travis Oliphant, provides fast numerical work on arrays. Wes McKinney began pandas at AQR in 2008 to make practical tabular analysis easier; it offers labeled
Series
and
DataFrame
objects. Large datasets can exceed memory, so choose dtypes and chunking carefully.
CORE EXPLANATION

NumPy provides homogeneous numeric arrays and vectorized computation. pandas provides labeled tables for filtering, grouping, and summarizing data such as CSV files. They are third-party dependencies; plain Python may be simpler for small inputs.
EXAMPLE CODE

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

samples = np.array([20.0, 22.0, 24.0])
readings = pd.DataFrame({'celsius': samples})
print(samples.mean(), readings['celsius'].max())

spans.title: Important tip
spans.text: Install with `python -m pip install numpy pandas` in the active `.venv`. Validate column types, missing values, and numeric ranges when loading data.

spans.title: Warning
spans.text: Loading a large file fully can exhaust RAM; use chunking and suitable dtypes, then validate results on a small sample.
